description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultMetadataHeaders class, which is a final class implementing the MetadataHeaders interface. It manages a collection of MetadataHeader objects in a thread-unsafe, sorted set, providing methods for parsing from JSON, serialization to JSON, and standard collection operations.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaders
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, sorted collection of MetadataHeader objects, with parsing and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultMetadataHeaders with an empty sorted set.

methods.name: parseMetadataHeaders
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence as JSON array to produce a DefaultMetadataHeaders instance.

methods.name: parseJsonArray
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray to a DefaultMetadataHeaders instance by parsing each JsonObject into a MetadataHeader.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the collection of MetadataHeaders to a JsonArray.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a MetadataHeader to the collection.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all MetadataHeaders from a collection.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the MetadataHeader collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified MetadataHeader from the collection.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all specified headers from the collection.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the headers in the specified collection.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of headers in the collection.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Returns the comparator used to order the headers.

methods.name: subSet
methods.description: Returns a view of the portion of the collection between two specified headers.

methods.name: headSet
methods.description: Returns a view of the collection with headers less than the specified header.

methods.name: tailSet
methods.description: Returns a view of the collection with headers greater than or equal to the specified header.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first header in the set.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last header in the set.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this collection with another for equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the collection.
